Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod.

He first posted 300. About ten minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 came from a combined staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of Jul 1, and Ruth confirmed it in the thread. Use 280 for the roster sheet.

That figure is from July. I haven't checked whether it has changed since.
